name: timmy-visual

supersedes.note: byte-for-byte the showpiece copy (also carried by order/hana-h2m6, older version 2026-09-12) plus the grid block and this header; the color / font / evidence / scale / material blocks are unchanged so the Spline and Hana lanes keep reading the same values.

note: LAW for every Timmy surface from ORDER ui-v3-t9r2 on (the TUI first). Black void, white structure, Avenir labels (terminal: case + weight + spacing stand in for the face), 8-column grid. Four semantic accents only: SEAL green (chain, sealed, verified), REFUSE red (governor / gate refusal only), PREDICT amber (sealed-before-build predictions, stale rims), GENERATED violet (anything a generative model made: measured:false). No other hue is admitted; grey is derived from black/white. Every element that carries evidence carries exactly one of the five evidence states.

seal.role: SEAL · receipts, hash links, verified, gate pass. Same phosphor as design/tokens.json chain.

refuse.role: REFUSE · governor refusal, gate fail. Never decorative.

predict.role: PREDICT · predicted counts, sealed forecasts, floating numerals before measurement

generated.role: GENERATED · model-made pixels/meshes, measured:false, Cosmos stills, AI textures

spline.note: Spline's font catalog has no Avenir; Outfit is the nearest geometric sans and is what the 3D Text objects use. The HTML code layer requests Avenir first and falls back through this list.

grid.note: The shell width divides into 8 equal columns; cards and rails span whole columns (120 cols → 15 cells per column, 80 cols → 10). Row budgets stay with the row solver; the grid governs width only.

evidence.note: Every element in the showpiece carries exactly one evidence state; selecting an element shows which (in Hana it is a named state on the object, so it is also toggleable as a preview). Declared = asserted, not yet built. Constructed = built, not yet checked. Checked = verified against a receipt or a measurement. Inferred = a model produced it (measured:false). Stale = was checked, but its inputs have changed since.

declared.role: outline only · asserted, not yet built

checked.role: SEAL green · verified against a receipt or a measurement

stale.role: dim + PREDICT amber · was checked, inputs changed since

hana.note: state id evidence-<name>, state name "evidence · <NAME>"; fill/stroke resolve through color.*

evidenceCarrier.note: Spline: every object carries ONE named state "evidence · <NAME>" (addState); the registry lanes/visual/data/evidence.json assigns it by object-name prefix; the HUD shows it on click in Play. Looks: declared = wireframe/outline, constructed = white fill, checked = seal emissive, inferred = generated emissive, stale = grey-3 + predict rim.
